answer: Since the vertex liability is logged with the signature, the spiral audit publishes who vouched, and self-sponsorship costs more than it saves. A farm has to recruit that support from outside its own cluster, because an internal co-signature is flagged on the summit graph and the sponsor's bond is exposed. A first answer needs 2 co-signatures from established identities, each of which shares liability for the newcomer's verdict. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
